data.description: A critical remote code execution vulnerability exists in the popular web framework when processing specially crafted serialized objects. An unauthenticated attacker can exploit this vulnerability by sending a malicious HTTP request containing a crafted payload, leading to arbitrary code execution with the privileges of the application. This vulnerability has been actively exploited in ransomware campaigns targeting enterprise applications.

kev.notes: Actively exploited in ransomware campaigns targeting healthcare and financial sectors. Patch immediately.

weaknesses.name: Deserialization of Untrusted Data
weaknesses.description: The software deserializes untrusted data without sufficiently verifying that the resulting data will be valid.

weaknesses.name: Improper Input Validation
weaknesses.description: The product receives input or data, but it does not validate or incorrectly validates that the input has the properties that are required to process the data safely and correctly.

attack_patterns.name: Object Injection
attack_patterns.description: An adversary exploits a weakness in input validation by injecting serialized objects in order to alter the behavior of the application.

attack_patterns.name: Privilege Escalation
